# Agritecture

> Agritecture is a global consulting firm specializing in controlled environment agriculture (CEA), urban farming design, and food system resilience strategy for entrepreneurs, investors, cities, and corporations.

Founded by Henry Gordon-Smith, Agritecture combines farm design expertise, feasibility analysis, and market research to help stakeholders navigate the indoor farming and vertical agriculture landscape. The firm has completed 250+ projects across 40+ countries and offers proprietary tools like Agritecture Designer for architects and developers.

## Key Topics

- Controlled Environment Agriculture (CEA)
- Urban Agriculture
- Vertical Farming
- Farm Design
- Feasibility Studies
- Due Diligence
- Food Systems Planning
- Market Research
- Sustainability
- Food Security
- Agritourism
- Climate-Smart Agriculture
- Agritecture Designer
- Indoor Farming

## Core Services

- [Consulting Services](https://www.agritecture.com/services): Agritecture consulting services: farm design, feasibility, market research
- [Farm Design](https://www.agritecture.com/farm-design): Urban farm design service: site analysis, HVAC, equipment, CEA layout
- [Feasibility Studies](https://www.agritecture.com/feasibility): CEA feasibility studies with business planning and sustainability assessment
- [Due Diligence](https://www.agritecture.com/due-diligence): Investment due diligence for CEA projects: risk analysis, technology assessment
- [Local Food System Planning](https://www.agritecture.com/planning): City-level food system planning with scenario analysis and resilience strategy
- [Agritourism Consulting](https://www.agritecture.com/agritourism): Agritourism consulting: farm experiences, sustainable practices, local food
- [Content & Marketing Services](https://www.agritecture.com/content-marketing-services): B2B content and marketing services for CEA and agritech companies

## Client Services

- [Entrepreneur Services](https://www.agritecture.com/entrepreneurs): Entrepreneur support: farm design, feasibility, CEA consulting, Designer tool
- [Investor Services](https://www.agritecture.com/investors): Investor services: due diligence, CEA operations analysis, industry research
- [Supplier Services](https://www.agritecture.com/suppliers): Supplier services: market research, product development, B2B partnerships
- [Cities & Municipalities](https://www.agritecture.com/cities): City consulting: food security, urban agriculture planning, resilience strategy
- [Corporate Services](https://www.agritecture.com/corporations): Corporate services: indoor farming consulting, market research, partnerships
- [Architect Services](https://www.agritecture.com/architects): Architect services: rooftop farming, Agritecture Designer software, workshops
